description: This file defines the Zend_Exception class, which is a custom exception class for the Zend Framework. It extends PHP's built-in Exception class and adds additional features such as handling previous exceptions and backward compatibility with PHP versions below 5.3.0.

classes.name: Zend_Exception
classes.description: A custom exception class that extends PHP's Exception and adds support for previous exceptions and backward compatibility.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for Zend_Exception, which initializes the exception with message, code, and optional previous exception, handling PHP version differences.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Magic method to handle calls to 'getPrevious' for PHP versions below 5.3.0, providing access to the previous exception.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the exception, including previous exception's details if applicable.

methods.name: _getPrevious
methods.description: Returns the previous exception stored internally, used for backward compatibility.
